text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the hallway, I<n>spot a
sleepy student letting out a yawn.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking so much about my<n>next race
that it's been keeping me up<n>at night.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I know how you feel. I always get really<n>nervous
when it's almost race time. Are<n>you okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Maybe not... I've been trying really hard<n>to stay
awake during class.
Stop right there, sleepy girl!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's a big no-no! You'll never conquer<n>the world
if you don't take care of<n>yourself!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Letting common sense get the better of<n>you...
Giving up on your ambitions... You<n>gotta take a
big ol' bite outta that<n>craziness!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text:
We are Worldwide Windy, the whirlwind<n>that digs
its teeth into the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're the only one who can hear your<n>body's
cries!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If your body wants rest, you must follow<n>your
instincts!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right! When you're sleepy, you<n>gotta take a
nap! Who cares if you're in<n>class or not!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In many other countries, it's tradition to<n>have a
little nap after lunch! They call it<n>a "siesta"!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's perfectly normal to sleep when<n>you're tired!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I get what you're saying, but still,<n>sleeping in class
can't be okay...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um... What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You should nap during your breaks.
You should get proper sleep at night.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not sure I'm comfortable sleeping<n>during
the day...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Not a problem! When it's day here in<n>Japan, it's
nighttime in America!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Uh, I guess so...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay! In that case, we just need to make<n>you feel
like you're in America at night!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Relax while listening to a Broadway<n>musical and
let sweet sleep whisk you<n>away!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if I'll be able to fall asleep.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you still have trouble sleeping, I'll just<n>
hypnotize you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my naps, I've been way more<n>alert, and
I can concentrate in class now!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Worldwide Windy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh! ♪ Looks like we've saved another<n>troubled
little lamb hidden away in this<n>corner of the
world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Letting common sense get the better of<n>you, what
a troubled little lamb you are.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I just wish there was something I could<n>do to make
myself fall into a deep sleep<n>at night...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Just run wild during the day, and then<n>you'll be so
worn out by bedtime that<n>you'll sleep like a baby!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heck, come with me right now! We can<n>go cause
some mischief!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Umm... mischief?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! It's time to break out from the<n>shell that
is common sense!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I've been sleeping all through the night<n>since
then, and my life's gotten back<n>into a nice
rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
And after outrunning the disciplinary<n>committee
for so long, even my race<n>times have improved!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: All according to my calculations!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
But it sounds like the two of you have<n>been called
to the student guidance<n>room...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Not a problem. We'll just tell the<n>teacher that we
did it all to save a lost<n>little lamb.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Here we go! Time to bust into that<n>guidance
room!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yes! Be grateful to us!
